items.headline: The Morning Build for November 12, 2026: Databricks' Genie in the C-suite, Nvidia's CEO Under Fire, TSMC's $1B AI Bets, and DeepMind's Signal Proof
items.excerpt: Databricks expands its Genie agent; Nvidia faces board and congressional scrutiny of CEO Jensen Huang; TSMC approved $1B for OpenAI and Anthropic; DeepMind formal-verified Signal.
